newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Abidjan bourse rises for fourth week.
newsitem.headline: Abidjan bourse rises for fourth week.

text.p: The Abidjan Stock Exchange (BVA) rose for the fourth straight week in the week to Friday due to a surge in blue-chip shares, the market report showed.
The All-Share Index rose 2.67 percent to 379.12 points, taking the increase for the year to 5.96 percent.
The 12 VB blue-chip index, which lagged in early January, surged 4.22 percent to 255.94 points, notching up a 5.77 percent rise on the year.
A total of 13,062 shares changed hands compared with 11,432 in the previous week, 4,079 in the week before that and 6,176 before that.
The value of shares traded totalled 258,220,500 CFA francs, down on the previous week's 315,515,500.
Blue chip brewer SOLIBRA ROSE 6,660 CFA to 71,760, fabric maker UNIWAX was up 5,770 to 62,420 and food company NESTLE-CI rose 3,500 to 60,000.
ELF OIL-CI fell 1,780 to 31,930, tar company SMB SMB.CI was down 1,200 to 21,800 and tobacco company SITAB was 970 lower at 47,000.
TOTAL-CI paid a 2,000 CFA per share dividend.
